mapper.select: SELECT E.BOOKSET_ID, A.BOOKSET_DATE, C.BUSI_ID, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID, C.INV_AIM, E.O_CCY, E.BAL_FLAG_HAPPEN_DATE, E.O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, E.NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, E.HAPPEN_DATE, E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, F.STANDARD_CCY FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A INNER JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT B ON (A.TASK_ID = #{taskId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.TASK_ID = B.SOURCE ) INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID C ON (A.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = C.BOK_DETAIL_ID ) INNER JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_DETAIL D ON (A.BOOKSET_ID = D.BOOKSET_ID AND A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = D.BOK_DETAIL_ID AND B.TARGET = D.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE ) INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT E ON (A.BOOKSET_ID = E.BOOKSET_ID AND A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = E.BOK_DETAIL_ID AND B.TARGET = E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = E.HAPPEN_DATE ) LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET F ON F.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID where A.BOOK_DATE <= E.BOOK_DATE AND (E.ONWAY_DATE <= A.HAPPEN_DATE OR E.ONWAY_DATE IS NULL) AND A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} ORDER BY E.BOOKSET_ID, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID, C.BUSI_ID

SELECT TASK_ID, BOOKSET_ID, BOOKSET_DATE, BUSI_ID, BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, BRANCH, BOK_DETAIL_ID, INV_AIM, O_CCY, BAL_FLAG_HAPPEN_DATE, O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, HAPPEN_DATE, BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, STANDARD_CCY, MDATE, IS_BACK_VALUE FROM( SELECT E.BOOKSET_ID, A.BOOKSET_DATE, A.TASK_ID, C.BUSI_ID, C.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE, E.BRANCH, E.BOK_DETAIL_ID, C.INV_AIM, E.O_CCY, E.BAL_FLAG_HAPPEN_DATE, Row_Number() OVER (partition by E.BOOKSET_ID ,E.BOK_DETAIL_ID,E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, E.O_CCY ORDER BY E.BOOK_ORDER desc) rank , E.O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, E.NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE, E.HAPPEN_DATE, E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE, F.STANDARD_CCY, E.MDATE, A.IS_BACK_VALUE ,E.ONWAY_DATE FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO A INNER JOIN BOK_MATCH_RLAT B2 ON A.TASK_ID = B2.SOURCE AND B2.MATCH_TYPE = #{matchType2} INNER JOIN BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT E ON A.BOOKSET_ID = E.BOOKSET_ID AND (A.BOK_DETAIL_ID = E.BOK_DETAIL_ID or A.BOK_DETAIL_ID is null)
AND E.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE IN
#{baseSubjectNature}
AND E.BOOK_DATE <= A.BOOK_DATE AND (E.OFFSET_DATE < #{BOOK_DATE} OR E.OFFSET_DATE IS NULL) AND (B2.TARGET is null or E.TABLE_ID IN B2.TARGET)
INNER JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID C ON (E.BOOKSET_ID = C.BOOKSET_ID AND E.BOK_DETAIL_ID = C.BOK_DETAIL_ID )
LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_TASK bt on bt.task_id = E.task_id
LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET F ON F.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID
WHERE 1=1 AND (E.HAPPEN_DATE < A.HAPPEN_DATE OR (E.HAPPEN_DATE = A.HAPPEN_DATE AND coalesce(bt.task_pri,E.TASK_PRI) < #{taskPri} ) ) AND A.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND A.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND A.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND A.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND A.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET} ORDER BY E.BOOKSET_ID, C.BUSI_ID, C.INV_AIM ) A WHERE A.rank = 1 AND (A.NUM_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE > 0 OR A.O_AMT_HAPPEN_DATE > 0 OR A.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} OR A.IS_BACK_VALUE = #{isBackValue} OR (A.ONWAY_DATE IS NOT NULL AND A.ONWAY_DATE >= #{HAPPEN_DATE}))
